title: Bifrost UDT Definition
description: Protocol-independent UDT data contract (Sparkplug Template-shaped, AAS-vocabulary aligned): the unit of source of truth in the Bifrost registry. A definition ≈ AAS Submodel; its members ≈ AAS Property. Language-neutral — any consumer can validate a definition document against this schema without depending on Bifrost code.

templateRef.description: This definition's own registry-key id (the UDT/template name it is filed under), or null.

version.description: SemVer of this definition, serialized as a major.minor.patch string.

members.description: UDT members (Sparkplug Template metrics); each member ≈ AAS Property.

conformsTo.description: Reserved pointer to an enterprise submodel-template this definition conforms to (AAS ConceptDescription intent); null on this track.

member.description: A UDT member ≈ AAS Property: name + type + semanticId, with an optional numeric range.

type.description: Type name, as returned by MetricDataType.toString(), e.g. "Double", "Boolean", "Int32".

semanticId.description: Optional concept-dictionary reference giving this member its meaning (AAS Property semanticId); populated by the northbound modeler, null for un-annotated/legacy members.

range.description: Numeric operating range (inclusive low/high), or null for non-numeric members.

param.description: A UDT template parameter: name + type.

type.description: Type name, as returned by ParameterDataType.toString(), e.g. "String", "Int32".
